purpose: Teach: 小冊子/鉄骨/凝縮/収める/経済学部/新株/チャーター/リクルート

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新製品の小冊子を作成しろ
lines.en: Create a new-product pamphlet for the company.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Crisp attack on the directive. Low, measured pace. The tone of someone who doesn't repeat himself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新ビルの鉄骨工事が始まりました
lines.en: Understood. The steel-frame construction on the new building has begun.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Brief pause after acknowledgment. Steady, matter-of-fact delivery. Reports the status without embellishment, eyes forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様の声を凝縮した広告を作れ
lines.en: Create an advertisement that distills customer feedback.
lines.style: Direct and purposeful. Slight weight on 'distills'—emphasizing the precision required. No softening. Brief, efficient. The voice of someone setting a standard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今期の業績を確実に収める所存です
lines.en: Understood. I intend to secure this quarter's performance without fail.
lines.style: Steady resolve underneath. Formal register—the kind of promise made in front of witnesses. Slight breath before 'without fail,' showing commitment. Shoulders back.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、経済学部出身者を採用しろ
lines.en: Hire economics graduates for the company.
lines.style: Clipped delivery. The tone of specific instruction. Minimal inflection—this is information, not negotiation. Lean forward slightly with the directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新株発行の準備が整いました
lines.en: Understood. The new share issuance preparations are complete.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction in the report. Professional tone, but a thread of completion underneath. Steady pacing. The update of someone who has cleared an obstacle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役員のチャーター便を手配しろ
lines.en: Arrange charter flights for the executives.
lines.style: Crisp, administrative. The tone of delegating logistics. No warmth, no hesitation. Brief and final—this is an instruction, not a discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。リクルートサイトに広告を出します
lines.en: Understood. We'll place advertisements on recruitment sites.
lines.style: Professional close. Calm acceptance. The tone of 'task noted and will be executed.' Slight nod in the delivery. Steady eye-contact level, wrapping up the exchange.
